title: Create Data Collector for Performance Counters

facts.text: Start Performance Monitor on server computer and create new user-defined Data Collector Set
Select performance counter type and add Business Central counters from available list
Choose all instances or specific server instances for which to collect data
Set root directory location for storing collected performance data log file
Data Collector Set appears under Data Collector Sets > User Defined after creation
Start or stop data collection by right-clicking Data Collector Set in navigation pane
